extracted.name: Kielbasa for the Big Game
extracted.description: Three ingredients and a slow cooker are all that are needed for this easy and tasty BBQ kielbasa party appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 4 pounds kielbasa (Polish) sausage (such as Hillshire Farm®), cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instruction_lines: Place kielbasa into a slow cooker. Add grape jelly and barbeque sauce.
Cook on Medium until hot, about 2 hours.
